Fix: re-run a deadlocked dashboard nav upsert instead of losing the rows
Sentry GUMROAD-1R4, production, 2026-09-25: INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE into dashboard_nav_promotions
deadlocked in the DashboardController#index before_action (seed_dashboard_nav_items), caught and reported.
File: app/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items.rb # record_nav_items
1) RED — spec against origin/main code (no retry), fix reverted in place
$ git show origin/main:app/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items.rb > app/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items.rb
$ grep -c CONTENTION_RETRIES app/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items.rb # 0, revert landed
$ DISABLE_SPRING=1 bundle exec rspec spec/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items_spec.rb
22 examples, 1 failure
rspec ./spec/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items_spec.rb:196 # re-runs an insert that deadlocked, so the seed still lands
2) GREEN — same spec against the branch head
$ git checkout HEAD -- app/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items.rb && grep -n CONTENTION_RETRIES <file>
20: CONTENTION_RETRIES = 2 76: raise if attempts > CONTENTION_RETRIES
$ DISABLE_SPRING=1 bundle exec rspec spec/models/concerns/user/dashboard_nav_items_spec.rb
22 examples, 0 failures (Finished in 4.37 seconds)
3) What the two new examples pin
- retry fires and the rows still land: attempts == 2, dashboard_nav_items_seeded? == true
- the ceiling is real: once CONTENTION_RETRIES is spent the deadlock re-raises to the caller's rescue
- no wrapping transaction on this path (Sellers::BaseController / DashboardController have none), so the
deadlocked statement has already rolled back whole when it is re-run
